description: A1' = Tmax target with labels v2 (season-gated Tmax rule), the parent of the A1'->A2->A2r chain. Versus v1 A1 it changes THREE things: labels, early stopping (inner_2y instead of val_block) and 2 fewer fitting years; a clean A1 vs A1' contrast would need an A1_inner config (v1 labels, inner_2y, 4 folds).
